intro: Djibouti's economy is built around its port, which handles most of Ethiopia's trade.

chapters.title: Port and railway
text: A new electric railway, built by China, links Djibouti to Addis Ababa. Rent from foreign bases is a big source of income.

chapters.title: Salt
text: Salt from Lake Assal has been traded for centuries.

cardGroups.title: Made in Djibouti
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Djibouti makes and sells to the world.
